  var marquee  = document.querySelector('.quarto-about-marquee');
  var contents = marquee && marquee.querySelector('.about-contents');
  var footer   = contents && contents.querySelector('.about-footer');
  var mainEl   = contents && contents.querySelector('main.content');
  var buttonsP = mainEl && mainEl.querySelector('p:first-child');

  // Pull social links and buttons into the hero card (before main body)
  if (footer  && mainEl) contents.insertBefore(footer,   mainEl);
  if (buttonsP && mainEl) contents.insertBefore(buttonsP, mainEl);

  // Move all remaining body content out to full-width below the hero row
  if (mainEl && marquee) marquee.appendChild(mainEl);
});
</script>
